testcase_name: Validate an already taken username
test_objective: Verify username validation endpoint returns valid=false for a username already in use.
test_steps: 1. On Add User screen, type a username that already exists
expected_results: Response indicates the username is not valid/available (already taken).

testcase_name: Validate username while editing own user (excluding self)
test_objective: Verify passing userId excludes that user's own current username from the uniqueness check.
test_steps: 1. Open Edit User screen for an existing user
2. Keep username unchanged and trigger validation, passing userId
expected_results: Response indicates the username is valid since the user's own record is excluded from the check.

testcase_name: Validate username exceeding 40 characters
test_objective: Verify username validation rejects values exceeding max length of 40 characters.
expected_results: Validation error is returned for exceeding max length.

testcase_name: View current email configuration
test_objective: Verify current email/SMTP configuration can be viewed, defaulting to SMTP/Login/SSL when not yet configured.
test_steps: 1. Navigate to Admin > Configuration > Mail Configuration
expected_results: Existing email configuration is displayed, or sensible defaults are shown if unconfigured.

testcase_name: Configure email with Sendmail mail type
test_objective: Verify mailType can be set to sendmail without requiring SMTP host/username/password.
test_steps: 1. Navigate to Admin > Configuration > Mail Configuration
3. Enter a valid Send As email address
expected_results: Configuration is saved successfully without requiring SMTP-specific fields.

testcase_name: Configure email with SMTP mail type and Login auth
test_objective: Verify smtpHost and smtpAuthType become required when mailType is smtp/secure_smtp, and smtpUsername/smtpPassword become required when authType is login.
test_steps: 1. Navigate to Admin > Configuration > Mail Configuration
4. Enter SMTP host, username and password
5. Enter a valid Send As email
expected_results: Configuration is saved successfully with all SMTP fields persisted.

testcase_name: Configure SMTP mail type without SMTP host
test_objective: Verify smtpHost is required when mailType is smtp or secure_smtp.
test_steps: 1. Navigate to Admin > Configuration > Mail Configuration
expected_results: Validation error is shown indicating SMTP host is required; configuration is not saved.

testcase_name: Configure email with invalid Send As email format
test_objective: Verify sentAs field must be a valid email address (max 100 chars).
test_steps: 1. Navigate to Admin > Configuration > Mail Configuration
2. Enter an invalid value in Send As field (e.g. 'notanemail')
expected_results: Validation error is shown for invalid email format; configuration is not saved.

testcase_name: Configure email with unsupported mail type
test_objective: Verify mailType must be one of sendmail, smtp, or secure_smtp.
test_steps: 1. Send update request with mailType set to an unsupported value
expected_results: Validation error is shown indicating mailType is not an allowed value; configuration is not saved.

testcase_name: Configure email with unsupported SMTP auth type
test_objective: Verify smtpAuthType must be one of the allowed auth type values (login/none).
test_steps: 1. Navigate to Admin > Configuration > Mail Configuration
3. Submit an unsupported Auth Type value
expected_results: Validation error is shown indicating the auth type is not allowed; configuration is not saved.

testcase_name: Send a test email after saving valid configuration
test_objective: Verify providing a testEmailAddress triggers a test email send and reports success/failure status.
test_steps: 1. Navigate to Admin > Configuration > Mail Configuration
3. Enter a valid Test Email Address
expected_results: Configuration is saved and testEmailStatus in the response indicates whether the test email was sent successfully (1) or failed (0).

testcase_name: Send a test email with invalid test email address format
test_objective: Verify testEmailAddress must be a valid email format (max 250 chars) when provided.
test_steps: 1. Navigate to Admin > Configuration > Mail Configuration
2. Enter an invalid value in Test Email Address field
expected_results: Validation error is shown for invalid email format; configuration is not saved.

testcase_name: List all email subscriptions
test_objective: Verify all available email subscription types (leave application, assignment, approval, cancellation, rejection) are listed.
test_steps: 1. Navigate to Admin > Configuration > Email Subscriptions
expected_results: All email subscription types are listed with their current enabled/disabled status.

testcase_name: Enable an email subscription
test_objective: Verify an email subscription can be enabled by setting enabled=true.
test_steps: 1. Navigate to Admin > Configuration > Email Subscriptions
expected_results: The subscription's enabled status is updated to true and persisted.

testcase_name: Disable an email subscription
test_objective: Verify an email subscription can be disabled by setting enabled=false.
test_steps: 1. Navigate to Admin > Configuration > Email Subscriptions
expected_results: The subscription's enabled status is updated to false and persisted.

testcase_name: Update email subscription with missing enabled field
test_objective: Verify enabled is a required boolean field for the update action.
test_steps: 1. Send update request for an email subscription without the enabled field
expected_results: Validation error is shown indicating enabled is required; update fails.

testcase_name: Update a non-existent email subscription
test_objective: Verify updating a subscription id that does not exist returns a not-found error.
test_steps: 1. Send update request with an invalid/non-existent subscription id
expected_results: A 404 Record Not Found response is returned.

testcase_name: Add a subscriber to a valid email subscription
test_objective: Verify a subscriber (name + email) can be added to a valid subscription type (e.g. Leave Application).
test_steps: 1. Navigate to Admin > Configuration > Email Subscriptions
expected_results: Subscriber is added successfully to the selected email subscription.

testcase_name: Add subscriber with missing name or email
test_objective: Verify name and email are both required to add a subscriber.
expected_results: Validation error is shown for the missing required field(s); subscriber is not added.

testcase_name: Add subscriber with invalid email format
test_objective: Verify subscriber email must be a valid email format (max 100 chars).
expected_results: Validation error is shown for invalid email format; subscriber is not added.

testcase_name: Add subscriber with duplicate email within the same subscription
test_objective: Verify subscriber email must be unique within the same email subscription (matchValues on emailNotification).
test_steps: 2. Add a subscriber with an email already subscribed to this subscription
expected_results: Validation error indicates the email already exists for this subscription; subscriber is not added.

testcase_name: Add subscriber to an invalid subscription id
test_objective: Verify emailSubscriptionId must be one of the allowed subscription types.
test_steps: 1. Send create request with an emailSubscriptionId that is not a valid subscription type
expected_results: Validation error is shown indicating the subscription id is not allowed.

testcase_name: List subscribers for a subscription with pagination
test_objective: Verify subscribers for a given subscription can be listed with sorting and pagination.
test_steps: 2. Apply sorting and page through results
expected_results: Subscribers are listed correctly sorted and paginated with correct total count and subscription name in meta.

testcase_name: Update an existing subscriber's name/email
test_objective: Verify an existing subscriber's name and email can be updated.
test_steps: 2. Edit an existing subscriber's name or email
expected_results: Subscriber details are updated successfully.

testcase_name: Delete one or more subscribers from a subscription
test_objective: Verify selected subscribers can be bulk deleted from a subscription.
expected_results: Selected subscribers are removed from the subscription list.

testcase_name: List all I18N languages filtered by activeOnly
test_objective: Verify the list of installed languages can be filtered using the required activeOnly parameter.
expected_results: List returns only enabled/added languages when activeOnly is true, and all languages otherwise.

testcase_name: Get a single I18N language by id
test_objective: Verify a specific installed language's details can be retrieved by id.
test_steps: 2. Select a language to view details
expected_results: Language details (code, name, enabled status) are displayed correctly.

testcase_name: Get an I18N language with an invalid id
test_objective: Verify requesting a non-existent language id returns a not-found error.
test_steps: 1. Send GET request for a language id that does not exist
expected_results: A 404 Record Not Found response is returned.

testcase_name: Enable (add) an I18N language
test_objective: Verify an available language can be enabled/added for use in the system (update with empty body sets added=true).
expected_results: The selected language is marked as added/enabled and becomes available for translation.

testcase_name: Delete one or more added I18N languages
test_objective: Verify one or more enabled languages can be removed/deleted from the system.
test_steps: 2. Select one or more enabled languages
expected_results: Selected languages are removed and no longer appear as enabled languages.

testcase_name: List translations for a language
test_objective: Verify translation strings for a specific languageId can be listed.
expected_results: List of source/translated text pairs for the selected language is displayed with correct total count.

testcase_name: Filter translations by source text
test_objective: Verify translations list can be filtered by sourceText (max 250 chars).
test_steps: 3. Enter search text in Source filter
expected_results: Only translation entries whose source text matches the filter are displayed.

testcase_name: Filter translations by translated text
test_objective: Verify translations list can be filtered by translatedText.
test_steps: 3. Enter search text in Translated Text filter
expected_results: Only translation entries whose translated text matches the filter are displayed.

testcase_name: Filter translations by group id
test_objective: Verify translations list can be filtered by a valid I18N group id.
test_steps: 2. Select a language and a translation group
expected_results: Only translation entries belonging to the selected group are displayed.

testcase_name: Filter to show only translated strings
test_objective: Verify the onlyTranslated boolean filter restricts results to strings that already have a translation.
expected_results: Only strings that already have a translated value are displayed.

testcase_name: List translations for a non-existent language id
test_objective: Verify listing translations for an invalid/non-existent languageId is handled gracefully.
test_steps: 1. Send GET request for translations with a languageId that does not exist
expected_results: Request is rejected or returns an empty result set with no server error.

testcase_name: List all I18N translation groups
test_objective: Verify all translation groups (module groupings for language strings) can be listed.
expected_results: All available translation groups are listed correctly with total count.

testcase_name: List I18N groups with sorting and pagination
test_objective: Verify the group list supports sortField, sortOrder, limit and offset.
test_steps: 1. Request I18N groups list with sort and pagination parameters
expected_results: Groups are returned correctly sorted and paginated.

testcase_name: View current default localization language and date format
test_objective: Verify the admin panel's default display language and date format can be retrieved.
expected_results: Current default language and date format are displayed.

testcase_name: Update default language to a supported language
test_objective: Verify default language can be updated to any value from the supported languages list.
test_steps: 2. Select a supported language from the dropdown
expected_results: Default language is updated successfully.

testcase_name: Update default language to an unsupported value
test_objective: Verify language must be one of the supported language codes.
test_steps: 1. Send update request with an unsupported/invalid language code
expected_results: Validation error is shown indicating the language is not supported; setting is not saved.

testcase_name: Update default date format to a supported format
test_objective: Verify default date format can be updated to any value from the supported date formats list.
expected_results: Default date format is updated successfully.

testcase_name: Update default date format to an unsupported value
test_objective: Verify dateFormat must be one of the supported date format keys.
test_steps: 1. Send update request with an unsupported/invalid date format value
expected_results: Validation error is shown indicating the date format is not supported; setting is not saved.

testcase_name: List all configurable modules with status
test_objective: Verify configurable modules (admin, pim, leave, time, recruitment, performance, maintenance, mobile, directory, claim, buzz) are listed with enabled/disabled status.
expected_results: All configurable modules are listed with their current enabled/disabled status.

testcase_name: Attempt to disable the Admin module
test_objective: Verify the Admin module cannot be disabled (must always remain true per TRUE_VAL rule).
test_steps: 2. Attempt to toggle Admin module to disabled
expected_results: Validation error is shown or Admin module remains enabled; it cannot be turned off.

testcase_name: Attempt to disable the PIM module
test_objective: Verify the PIM module cannot be disabled (must always remain true per TRUE_VAL rule).
test_steps: 2. Attempt to toggle PIM module to disabled
expected_results: Validation error is shown or PIM module remains enabled; it cannot be turned off.

testcase_name: Enable/disable the Leave module
test_objective: Verify non-core modules such as Leave can be toggled on and off.
expected_results: Leave module status is updated and persisted correctly.

testcase_name: Enable/disable the Mobile module
test_objective: Verify Mobile module toggle updates the mobile OAuth client status accordingly.
expected_results: Mobile module status is updated and the associated OAuth mobile client status changes accordingly.

testcase_name: Update modules with an invalid boolean value
test_objective: Verify module status fields must be boolean typed.
test_steps: 1. Send update request with a non-boolean value for a module field (e.g. leave='yes')
expected_results: Validation error is shown for invalid boolean type; update fails.

testcase_name: Create a subunit under a valid parent
test_objective: Verify a new subunit can be created with a required unique name and a valid parentId.
test_steps: 1. Navigate to Admin > Organization > Organization Structure
2. Select a parent unit and click Add
expected_results: Subunit is created successfully under the selected parent in the organization tree.

testcase_name: Create a subunit with unit id and description
test_objective: Verify optional unitId (<=100 chars) and description (<=400 chars) can be set on a subunit.
test_steps: 1. Navigate to Admin > Organization > Organization Structure > Add
2. Enter name, unit id and description
expected_results: Subunit is created with unit id and description saved correctly.

testcase_name: Create a subunit with missing name
test_objective: Verify name is required to create a subunit.
test_steps: 1. Navigate to Admin > Organization > Organization Structure > Add
expected_results: Validation error is shown indicating name is required; subunit is not created.

testcase_name: Create a subunit without selecting a parent
test_objective: Verify parentId is required when creating a subunit.
test_steps: 1. Navigate to Admin > Organization > Organization Structure > Add
expected_results: Validation error is shown indicating a parent unit is required; subunit is not created.

testcase_name: Create a subunit under a non-existent parent
test_objective: Verify creation fails if the specified parentId does not correspond to an existing subunit.
test_steps: 1. Send create request with a parentId that does not exist
expected_results: A 404 Record Not Found response is returned; subunit is not created.

testcase_name: Create a subunit with duplicate name
test_objective: Verify subunit name must be unique across the organization structure.
test_steps: 1. Navigate to Admin > Organization > Organization Structure > Add
2. Enter a name that already exists elsewhere in the structure
expected_results: Validation error indicates the name already exists; subunit is not created.

testcase_name: View organization structure in tree mode
test_objective: Verify subunits can be retrieved in hierarchical tree mode using mode=tree.
test_steps: 1. Navigate to Admin > Organization > Organization Structure
2. View the structure in tree/hierarchy view
expected_results: Organization units are displayed correctly nested according to their parent-child relationships.

testcase_name: Attempt to delete the top-level organization unit (id=1)
test_objective: Verify the root organization unit cannot be deleted (id must be greater than 1).
test_steps: 1. Navigate to Admin > Organization > Organization Structure
2. Attempt to delete the top-level unit
expected_results: Validation error is shown preventing deletion of the top-level organization unit.

testcase_name: Delete a non-root subunit
test_objective: Verify a subunit other than the root unit can be deleted.
test_steps: 1. Navigate to Admin > Organization > Organization Structure
expected_results: The selected subunit is deleted and removed from the organization structure.

testcase_name: Add a currency to a pay grade with valid min/max salary
test_objective: Verify a currency can be added to a pay grade with minSalary less than maxSalary, both within allowed range and decimal precision.
test_steps: 1. Navigate to Admin > Job > Pay Grades > select a Pay Grade > Add Currency
3. Enter min salary and max salary (min < max)
expected_results: Currency with min/max salary range is added successfully to the pay grade.

testcase_name: Add a currency with min salary greater than or equal to max salary
test_objective: Verify the business rule that minSalary must be less than maxSalary (unless minSalary is 0).
test_steps: 1. Navigate to a Pay Grade's Add Currency screen
3. Enter min salary equal to or greater than max salary
expected_results: Error is returned: 'Min salary should be less than max salary'; currency is not added.

testcase_name: Add a currency with min salary of 0
test_objective: Verify minSalary of exactly 0 is treated as a special case and does not trigger the min<max comparison bypass incorrectly.
test_steps: 1. Navigate to a Pay Grade's Add Currency screen
3. Set min salary = 0 and max salary = any positive value
expected_results: Currency is added successfully with min salary 0.

testcase_name: Add a currency with salary exceeding maximum allowed value
test_objective: Verify salary values must be less than 1,000,000,000 (PARAM_RULE_SALARY_MAX_VALUE).
test_steps: 1. Navigate to a Pay Grade's Add Currency screen
expected_results: Validation error is shown for exceeding the maximum allowed salary value; currency is not added.

testcase_name: Add a currency with more than 2 decimal places in salary
test_objective: Verify salary values only allow up to 2 decimal places (DECIMAL rule 0/1/2).
test_steps: 1. Navigate to a Pay Grade's Add Currency screen
2. Enter a salary value with 3 decimal places (e.g. 1000.123)
expected_results: Validation error is shown for invalid decimal precision; currency is not added.

testcase_name: Add a currency to a non-existent pay grade
test_objective: Verify adding a currency fails if the specified payGradeId does not exist.
test_steps: 1. Send create request with a payGradeId that does not exist
expected_results: A 404 Record Not Found response is returned; currency is not added.

testcase_name: Update min/max salary for an existing pay grade currency
test_objective: Verify min and max salary for an already-assigned currency can be updated.
test_steps: 1. Open an existing pay grade's currency list
2. Edit an assigned currency's min/max salary
expected_results: Min/max salary values are updated successfully for that currency.

testcase_name: Delete one or more currencies from a pay grade
test_objective: Verify selected currencies can be bulk removed from a pay grade.
test_steps: 1. Open a pay grade's currency list
expected_results: Selected currencies are removed from the pay grade's currency list.

testcase_name: List currencies available to assign to a pay grade
test_objective: Verify only currencies not already assigned to a given pay grade are listed as allowed/available.
test_steps: 1. Navigate to a Pay Grade's Add Currency screen
expected_results: Only currencies not yet assigned to the pay grade are listed as selectable options.

testcase_name: List allowed currencies with sorting and pagination
test_objective: Verify the allowed currencies list supports sortField, sortOrder, limit and offset.
test_steps: 1. Request allowed currencies for a pay grade with sort and pagination parameters
expected_results: Allowed currencies are returned correctly sorted and paginated with correct total count.

testcase_name: List allowed currencies for a non-existent pay grade
test_objective: Verify requesting allowed currencies for an invalid payGradeId is handled correctly.
test_steps: 1. Send GET request for allowed currencies with a payGradeId that does not exist
expected_results: Validation error or empty result set is returned with no server error.

testcase_name: Retrieve job specification attachment for a job title that has one
test_objective: Verify the job specification file metadata/content can be retrieved for a job title with an attached specification.
test_steps: 2. Open a job title that has an attached specification
expected_results: Job specification file details are returned and the file can be downloaded correctly.

testcase_name: Retrieve job specification for a job title with no attachment
test_objective: Verify requesting the job specification for a job title without one returns a not-found error.
test_steps: 1. Open a job title that has no attached specification
expected_results: A 404 Record Not Found response is returned.

testcase_name: Retrieve job specification for a non-existent job title id
test_objective: Verify requesting a job specification using an invalid jobTitleId is handled correctly.
test_steps: 1. Send GET request for job specification with a jobTitleId that does not exist
expected_results: A 404 Record Not Found response or validation error is returned.
